messages:
maria: heads up — starting canary for runtime v2.3.1 in 10m (window 03:00-03:30 UTC). Need router pin to v1.8.4 and console pinned to 2.3.1-beta. Jamal can you confirm API feature flag gating? @jamal
jamal: saw this. API will do 20% traffic slice to canary route. feature flag already open, but we need header-swap in router to preserve session affinity. I'll coordinate.
liam: deploy-bot scheduled wave at 03:10 UTC. pin requests submitted to router and console. deploy-bot: queued -> starting in 8m :robot_face:
deploy-bot: deploy ticket #D-8231 created. canary targets: runtime: 10 hosts, router: header-swap flow, console: pinned variant. logs -> /ops/deploys/D-8231
helen: rollback criteria: >3% 5xx for 2 consecutive 5-min windows OR latency p95 increase >200ms. If triggered we'll pin back router to v1.8.3 and runtime to v2.2.9. agree?
sara: also need release notes + customer impact blurb. I'll update the docs page and add a line in the release digest. who owns the console blurb?
maria: @sara please add console note. liam pls ensure action item for ops to verify KVS warm-up. also confirm cache-populate job runs after canary starts.
jamal: small note on KV: runtime change touches eviction policy. We'll run a warmup job: `./kvs-warmup --namespace=canary --keys=10k` right after traffic shift.
liam: acked, warmup scheduled at 03:12. deploy-bot: will run post-deploy hook. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Canary started at 1789004331. traffic 20% -> canary. Monitoring: latency, errors, kv-hit-rate.
maria: monitoring dashboards linked: https://console.redwood/graphs/D-8231 (check p95, 5xx, kv hit). If no alerts by 03:22 we ramp to 50% then full at 03:28 per plan.
helen: prepping rollback actions now; I've staged the pin back config and added rollback playbook to the ticket.
jamal: noted. If we need to abort early, signal `abort-canary D-8231` in this thread. keep chatter minimal.
sara: release notes draft at https://docs.redwood/releases/2.3.1-canary.md - added console section. please proof.
maria: thanks all. will post final roll/ramp steps in 5m. :rocket:
